pin_regs.reason: ECTL static calendar: QK_ISSUE_AGE, ROW_RETURN_LAT (=K_EXT 16 + RQD 2 + 3 response pin stages) and HXK count every boundary edge of the K-pass / row-return loop inside the RTL; synthesis-only pin registers (+1 per port) would shift the fixed-cycle issue/return by edges the RTL constants and the native benches do not see (age fault). Pin registration for this leaf must be done in RTL with the constants re-derived (KV die lead / Q-ATTN decision). Pin geometry, outline and io_flop_at_pins unchanged from the closed kit.
